functionalGoals.name: Maintain effective supplier governance, issue control and resilience
functionalGoals.definition: Supplier governance activities; issue handling and escalation; supplier performance/risk reviews.

functionalGoals.name: Improve controllable cost efficiency and budget discipline
functionalGoals.definition: Verified cost savings; expenditure within approved budget tolerance; purchasing/payment controls; realized improvement benefits.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain reliable operational controls and usable policies
functionalGoals.definition: Administrative control completion and operational policy, SOP and guide readiness.

functionalGoals.name: Deliver strategic projects and realize their intended benefits
functionalGoals.definition: Accepted strategic milestones and independently verified project benefits.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain portfolio governance and resolve delivery risks and dependencies
functionalGoals.definition: Portfolio delivery health; risk/dependency action and recovery; cross-functional commitments outside project milestones.

functionalGoals.name: Realize transformation benefits and adoption
functionalGoals.definition: Approved transformation initiatives meeting both benefit and adoption criteria.

functionalGoals.name: Operate effective performance reviews and corrective action
functionalGoals.definition: Performance reviews and corrective actions completed within governance requirements.

functionalGoals.name: Build workforce readiness and maintain people governance
functionalGoals.definition: Workforce/capability plan readiness and timely completion of HR governance controls.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain employee attendance, punctuality and workplace compliance
functionalGoals.definition: Common HR measures: punctuality/attendance, unplanned absenteeism and workplace/HR compliance.

functionalGoals.name: Deliver timely, accountable support case handling
functionalGoals.definition: Ticket claim and ownership; handover; meaningful response; escalation; resolution and closure.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain support quality, controls and SOP adherence
functionalGoals.definition: Audited response quality; support operational controls; SOP/guide adherence.

functionalGoals.name: Strengthen support team performance and customer retention
functionalGoals.definition: Team functional performance; support-controllable retention; service improvements and enablement.

functionalGoals.name: Generate qualified commercial demand and progress opportunities
functionalGoals.definition: Qualified prospects/leads, SQLs, qualified pipeline and opportunity progression.

functionalGoals.name: Validate markets and execute commercialization and growth initiatives
functionalGoals.definition: Market validation; commercialization readiness; campaign/market execution and assigned strategic initiatives.

functionalGoals.name: Build reliable GTM automation and commercial enablement
functionalGoals.definition: GTM automation/CRM optimization delivery and required framework, process and enablement readiness.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain trusted, reconciled commercial and company data
functionalGoals.definition: Data integrity; data-quality issue resolution; cross-system reconciliation; CRM data/process compliance.

functionalGoals.name: Provide timely market intelligence and decision-ready reporting
functionalGoals.definition: Strategic and operational GTM analyses; business reports and BI readiness.

functionalGoals.name: Improve data capability and KPI measurement readiness
functionalGoals.definition: Data automation benefits; validated KPI data readiness; data governance/documentation.

functionalGoals.name: Acquire customers and convert qualified demand into profitable sales
functionalGoals.definition: Commissionable profit; customer acquisition; qualified outbound; sales conversion.

functionalGoals.name: Retain and expand existing customer value
functionalGoals.definition: Existing-base revenue retention; expansion; assigned at-risk recovery; quality sales.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain reliable sales pipeline and CRM discipline
functionalGoals.definition: Sales pipeline and CRM compliance.

functionalGoals.name: Deliver accepted engineering, product and customer-project outputs
functionalGoals.definition: Timely accepted engineering deliverables, product enhancements, customer projects and technical support outputs.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain engineering quality and resolve technical issues
functionalGoals.definition: First-time-right delivery and priority/SLA-compliant bug and technical issue action.

functionalGoals.name: Develop the technical ecosystem and realize improvement benefits
functionalGoals.definition: Technical roadmap/ecosystem delivery and verified technical improvement benefits.

functionalGoals.name: Strengthen engineering governance, capability and team performance
functionalGoals.definition: Work-management controls; technical standards/documentation; team functional performance and demonstrated capability.

functionalGoals.name: Deliver usable designs and commercially relevant product experiences
functionalGoals.definition: Accepted design and product/feature outputs; first-time-right quality.

functionalGoals.name: Improve user experience and design consistency
functionalGoals.definition: UI/UX audits and corrective actions; design system consistency; measurable improvement benefits.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain usable UI/UX documentation
functionalGoals.definition: Current, complete UI/UX documentation meeting readiness requirements.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain reliable websites and timely issue control
functionalGoals.definition: Website availability; preventive monitoring; audit/corrective action; priority/SLA-compliant issue resolution.

functionalGoals.name: Deliver quality web capabilities and measurable commercial improvements
functionalGoals.definition: Accepted commercial enablement/web outputs; first-time-right development; verified improvement benefits.

functionalGoals.name: Maintain web operational and documentation readiness
functionalGoals.definition: Required web operational controls and usable documentation.
